Interface SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry

All Known Subinterfaces:
SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry.Builder
@NonExtendable public interface SulfurCubeArchetypeRegistryEntry
A data-centric version-specific registry entry for the SulfurCube.Archetype type.
